info.title: paspan-code-graph-mcp: a read-only MCP server (stdio) for C# and C++ code analysis by AI agents.
info.description: Read-only MCP server for C# and C++ code analysis by AI agents: declarations, type hierarchy, references, call graph and GraphRAG retrieval (search, context within a token budget, impact of a change), built with PaspanParsers instead of Roslyn or clang and without MSBuild.

options.name: --no-watch
options.description: do not update the graph when files change         (PASPAN_WATCH=0)

options.name: --no-cache
options.description: do not keep the graph in .paspan/graph.bin        (PASPAN_CACHE=0)
